{{Quote|A military and humanitarian crisis has erupted on the planet Cademimu. Governor Chornarov has declared independence from the Republic and stolen vital armaments that protect an entire star sector.|[[Satele Shan]] during the [[Cademimu uprising]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Cademimu sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Cademimu included [[Patch-4]] in the [[Patch system/Legends|Patch system]], [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaeda]] in [[Phaeda system/Legends|Phaeda system]], [[Smarck]] in the [[Smarck system/Legends|Smarck system]] and those of the [[Mosu system]]. The [[Bazarre]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] was also located there.
